wiki.title: The Store Next Door
wiki.body:
The cursed storefront on the other side of Bob's Burgers, perpetually **FOR LEASE**.

## The gag
Every episode's opening credits shows a different doomed business setting up shop here — pest control, yarn stores, crematorium supply outlets — before it inevitably fails and the sign goes back up.

## Notes
- Blink-and-you-miss-it store names are one of the show's longest-running jokes
- Nothing survives here. Nothing.
